title: Minecraft 26.3 Snapshot 5
author: Java Team
imageAltText: A black Sheep in a Dappled Forest is looking out in the horizon.

blocks.source_text: Happy Snapshot day! Today we are shipping the 5th snapshot of 26.3 with a fresh batch of updates and improvements.
blocks.translated_text: 快乐的游戏快照日！今天我们发布了26.3版本的第五个快照，其中包含了许多新的更新和改进。

blocks.source_text: Happy mining!
blocks.translated_text: 祝你采矿愉快！

blocks.source_text: Technical Changes
blocks.translated_text: 技术变更

blocks.source_text: The Data Pack version is now 112.0
blocks.translated_text: 数据包版本现已更新至112.0

blocks.source_text: The Resource Pack version is now 93.0
blocks.translated_text: 资源包版本现已更新至93.0

blocks.source_text: Data Pack Version 112.0
blocks.translated_text: 数据包版本112.0

blocks.source_text: Codec for element lists/tags now allows mixing inline values and references
blocks.translated_text: 元素列表/标签的编码格式现在支持混合内联值和引用

blocks.source_text: For example, item modifiers like [{type:set_count, ...}, "minecraft:some_modifier"] are now allowed
blocks.translated_text: 例如，像[{type:set_count, ...}, "minecraft:somemodifier"]这样的物品修饰符现在被允许使用了

blocks.source_text: World Generation
blocks.translated_text: 世界生成机制

blocks.source_text: Features
blocks.translated_text: 新增功能

blocks.source_text: Changed
blocks.translated_text: 已更改

blocks.source_text: minecraft:sculk_patch
blocks.translated_text: minecraft:sculk_patch

blocks.source_text: Removed extra_rare_growths and catalyst_chance fields
blocks.translated_text: 移除了 extra_rare_growths 和 catalyst_chance 字段

blocks.source_text: Resource Pack Version 93.0
blocks.translated_text: 资源包版本 93.0

blocks.source_text: Shaders & Post-process Effects
blocks.translated_text: 着色器与后期处理效果

blocks.source_text: Order-independent Transparency (OIT)-related Shader Changes
blocks.translated_text: 与 Order-Independent Transparency (OIT) 相关的着色器更改

blocks.source_text: The B3D_IS_ZERO_TO_ONE define has been renamed to RENDERPEARL_IS_ZERO_TO_ONE
blocks.translated_text: B3D_IS_ZERO_TO“One 定义已重命名为 RENDERPEARL_IS_ZERO_TO_ONE

blocks.source_text: Shader Compilation Changes
blocks.translated_text: 着色器编译方面的更改

blocks.source_text: Shaders are now compiled by ShaderC when using OpenGL as well, identically to when using Vulkan
blocks.translated_text: 现在在使用 OpenGL 时，着色器也会由 ShaderC 进行编译，与使用 Vulkan 时的处理方式相同

blocks.source_text: Shader includes are now handled by ShaderC using #include instead of #moj_import
blocks.translated_text: 着色器包含文件现在通过 #include 而不是 #moj_import 进行处理

blocks.source_text: Shader inputs and outputs must have a location specified in shader source
blocks.translated_text: 着色器的输入和输出必须在着色器源代码中指定位置

blocks.source_text: Vertex input names must still match expected names.
blocks.translated_text: 顶点输入的名称必须与预期的名称相匹配

blocks.source_text: Vertex outputs are matched to fragment inputs solely by location, name is now ignored.
blocks.translated_text: 顶点输出现在仅通过位置与片段输入匹配，名称不再被考虑

blocks.source_text: Introduced new define RENDERPEARL_INSTANCE_INDEX_INCLUDES_BASE_INSTANCE - A boolean indicating if gl_InstanceIndex follows Vulkan or OpenGL ( gl_InstanceID ) semantics
blocks.translated_text: 引入了新的宏 `define RENDERPEARL_INSTANCE_INDEX_INCLUDES_BASE_INSTANCE`——一个布尔值，用于指示 `gl_InstanceIndex` 是遵循 Vulkan 的语义还是 OpenGL 的语义

blocks.source_text: **Developer's Note**: *Vertex inputs in previous versions using OpenGL were not allowed to specify a location. Compatability can be preserved by only specifying locations when the "VULKAN" macro is defined.*
blocks.translated_text: **开发者注释**：*在早期版本中，使用 OpenGL 的顶点输入不允许指定位置。如果定义了 `VULKAN` 宏，可以通过仅指定位置来保持兼容性*

blocks.source_text: **Developer's Note**: *Vertex outputs and fragment inputs in previous versions were matched based on name alone. Compatability can be preserved by continuing to use identical names.*
blocks.translated_text: **开发者注释**：*在早期版本中，顶点输出和片段输入仅通过名称进行匹配。可以通过继续使用相同的名称来保持兼容性*

blocks.source_text: Fixed bugs in 26.3 Snapshot 5
blocks.translated_text: 修复了 26.3 快照 5 中的错误

blocks.source_text: [MC-5269](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-5269) - Updating a server's address in the multiplayer menu does not update its status
blocks.translated_text: [MC-5269] - 在多人游戏菜单中更新服务器地址后，服务器的状态并未随之更新

blocks.source_text: [MC-278771](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-278771) - The incorrect command context is used when providing suggestions for redirected commands
blocks.translated_text: [MC-278771] - 在为重定向命令提供建议时，使用了错误的命令上下文

blocks.source_text: [MC-293755](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-293755) - The ender dragon's neck and tail disconnect from its body when it turns
blocks.translated_text: [MC-293755] - 恶龙在转身时，它的颈部和尾部会与身体分离

blocks.source_text: [MC-306628](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-306628) - TNT minecarts don't delete piercing arrows
blocks.translated_text: [MC-306628] - TNT矿车不会清除穿透箭矢

blocks.source_text: [MC-307918](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-307918) - Sculk patches can cause errors in the log during world generation
blocks.translated_text: [MC-307918] - Sculk补丁在世界生成过程中可能会导致日志错误

blocks.source_text: [MC-308344](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-308344) - Validation error when compiling shaders containing in/out array or matrix variables with the Vulkan rendering backend
blocks.translated_text: [MC-308344] - 在使用Vulkan渲染后端编译含有in/out数组或矩阵变量的着色器时，会出现验证错误

blocks.source_text: [MC-308406](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-308406) - Item models are shown incorrectly in the smithing table menu's armor stand
blocks.translated_text: [MC-308406](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-308406) - 铁匠台菜单中的盔甲架显示的物品模型不正确

blocks.source_text: [MC-308647](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-308647) - The resource packs screen can cache font glyphs incorrectly after toggling the "Font Settings" option
blocks.translated_text: [MC-308647](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-308647) - 在切换“字体设置”选项后，资源包界面可能会错误地缓存字体字符

blocks.source_text: [MC-309250](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-309250) - Naturally generated decorated pots don't drop bricks when broken with tools
blocks.translated_text: [MC-309250] - 自然生成的装饰性陶罐在用工具破坏时不会掉落砖块

blocks.source_text: [MC-309298](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-309298) - Sending chat messages while having the "Chat Delay" option set to a nonzero value can sometimes kick you from the game
blocks.translated_text: [MC-309298] - 当“聊天延迟”选项设置为非零值时发送聊天消息可能会导致玩家被踢出游戏

blocks.source_text: [MC-309500](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-309500) - Crafting decorated pots without sherds using the recipe book creates a pot that doesn't drop bricks when broken with a tool
blocks.translated_text: [MC-309500] - 使用配方书制作装饰性陶罐但不使用碎片时，制成的陶罐在用工具破坏时也不会掉落砖块

blocks.source_text: [MC-309565](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-309565) - Block outlines are rendered behind translucent elements if the "High Contrast Block Outlines" option is enabled
blocks.translated_text: [MC-309565] - 如果启用了“高对比度块轮廓”（High Contrast Block Outlines）选项，块轮廓会显示在半透明元素后面

blocks.source_text: [MC-309566](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-309566) - Block outlines are rendered behind translucent elements if the "Improved Transparency" option is disabled
blocks.translated_text: [MC-309566] - 如果禁用了“改进的透明度”（Improved Transparency）选项，块轮廓仍会显示在半透明元素后面

blocks.source_text: [MC-309743](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-309743) - The attacking animation of drowned is incorrect
blocks.translated_text: [MC-309743] - 淹死的角色的攻击动画有误

blocks.source_text: [MC-310041](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-310041) - Under specific conditions, chunk loading frequently fails
blocks.translated_text: [MC-310041] - 在特定条件下，区块加载会频繁失败

blocks.source_text: [MC-310096](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-310096) - Invalid item modifiers crash the game
blocks.translated_text: [MC-310096] - 无效的物品修饰符会导致游戏崩溃

blocks.source_text: [MC-310098](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-310098) - Trying to mix item modifier references and inline values in a list prevents the pack from loading
blocks.translated_text: [MC-310098] - 在列表中混合使用物品修饰符引用和内联值会导致资源包无法加载

blocks.source_text: [MC-310125](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-310125) - Blaze powder in brewing stands uses the cooking/speed_default number provider instead of brewing/speed_default
blocks.translated_text: [MC-310125] - 在酿造台中使用烈焰粉（Blaze powder）时，系统会调用烹饪（cooking）相关的速度设置（speed_default），而非酿造（brewing）相关的速度设置

blocks.source_text: [MC-310133](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-310133) - Gurgles do not aim their tridents correctly
blocks.translated_text: [MC-310133] - 幼年溺尸（Gurgles）无法正确瞄准它们的三叉戟

blocks.source_text: [MC-310135](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-310135) - The server crashes when requesting command suggestions for /attribute referenced from /execute
blocks.translated_text: [MC-310135] - 当执行 `/execute` 命令并引用 `/attribute` 时，服务器会崩溃

blocks.source_text: [MC-310149](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-310149) - Glass flickers when looking at it closely with the Vulkan rendering backend and the "Improved Transparency" option enabled
blocks.translated_text: [MC-310149] - 在使用 Vulkan 渲染引擎且开启了“改进透明度”（Improved Transparency）选项的情况下，玻璃在仔细观察时会闪烁

blocks.source_text: [MC-310163](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-310163) - The game crashes when entering exclusive fullscreen on Wayland
blocks.translated_text: [MC-310163] - 在 Wayland 显示模式下进入全屏模式时，游戏会崩溃

blocks.source_text: Get the Snapshot
blocks.translated_text: 获取更新快照

blocks.source_text: Snapshots are available for Minecraft: Java Edition. To install the Snapshot, open up the [Minecraft Launcher](https://www.minecraft.net/content/minecraft-net/language-masters/download) and enable snapshots in the "Installations" tab.
blocks.translated_text: Minecraft: Java版现在提供了快照功能。要安装快照，请打开[Minecraft启动器](https://www.minecraft.net/content/minecraft-net/language-masters/download)，并在“安装”选项卡中启用快照功能。

blocks.source_text: **Testing versions can corrupt your world, so please backup and/or run them in a different folder from your main worlds.**
blocks.translated_text: **测试版本可能会损坏你的游戏世界，因此请先备份数据，或者将测试版本运行在与主世界不同的文件夹中。**

blocks.source_text: Cross-platform server jar:
blocks.translated_text: 跨平台服务器jar文件：

blocks.source_text: [Minecraft server jar](https://piston-data.mojang.com/v1/objects/bc881a3fc6e63c490e614ab3bf9c43adc0449ab2/server.jar)
blocks.translated_text: [Minecraft服务器jar文件](https://piston-data.mojang.com/v1/objects/bc881a3fc6e63c490e614ab3bf9c43adc0449ab2/server.jar)”

blocks.source_text: Report bugs here:
blocks.translated_text: 在这里报告错误：

blocks.source_text: [Minecraft issue tracker](https://bugs.mojang.com/projects/MC/summary) !
blocks.translated_text: [Minecraft问题追踪器](https://bugs.mojang.com/projects/MC/summary)！

blocks.source_text: Want to give feedback?
blocks.translated_text: 想要提供反馈吗？

blocks.translated_text: 如有任何反馈或建议，请访问[反馈网站](https://feedback.minecraft.net/)。如果你喜欢聊天，也可以加入我们的[官方 Minecraft Discord 频道](https://discordapp.com/invite/minecraft)。

content:
Happy Snapshot day! Today we are shipping the 5th snapshot of 26.3 with a fresh batch of updates and improvements.

Happy mining!

Technical Changes

The Data Pack version is now 112.0

The Resource Pack version is now 93.0

Data Pack Version 112.0

Codec for element lists/tags now allows mixing inline values and references

For example, item modifiers like [{type:set_count, ...}, "minecraft:some_modifier"] are now allowed

World Generation

Features

Changed

minecraft:sculk_patch

Removed extra_rare_growths and catalyst_chance fields

Resource Pack Version 93.0

Shaders & Post-process Effects

Order-independent Transparency (OIT)-related Shader Changes

The B3D_IS_ZERO_TO_ONE define has been renamed to RENDERPEARL_IS_ZERO_TO_ONE

Shader Compilation Changes

Shaders are now compiled by ShaderC when using OpenGL as well, identically to when using Vulkan

Shader includes are now handled by ShaderC using #include instead of #moj_import

Shader inputs and outputs must have a location specified in shader source

Vertex input names must still match expected names.

Vertex outputs are matched to fragment inputs solely by location, name is now ignored.

Introduced new define RENDERPEARL_INSTANCE_INDEX_INCLUDES_BASE_INSTANCE - A boolean indicating if gl_InstanceIndex follows Vulkan or OpenGL ( gl_InstanceID ) semantics

**Developer's Note**: *Vertex inputs in previous versions using OpenGL were not allowed to specify a location. Compatability can be preserved by only specifying locations when the "VULKAN" macro is defined.*

**Developer's Note**: *Vertex outputs and fragment inputs in previous versions were matched based on name alone. Compatability can be preserved by continuing to use identical names.*

Fixed bugs in 26.3 Snapshot 5

[MC-5269](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-5269) - Updating a server's address in the multiplayer menu does not update its status

[MC-278771](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-278771) - The incorrect command context is used when providing suggestions for redirected commands

[MC-293755](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-293755) - The ender dragon's neck and tail disconnect from its body when it turns

[MC-306628](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-306628) - TNT minecarts don't delete piercing arrows

[MC-307918](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-307918) - Sculk patches can cause errors in the log during world generation

[MC-308344](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-308344) - Validation error when compiling shaders containing in/out array or matrix variables with the Vulkan rendering backend

[MC-308406](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-308406) - Item models are shown incorrectly in the smithing table menu's armor stand

[MC-308647](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-308647) - The resource packs screen can cache font glyphs incorrectly after toggling the "Font Settings" option

[MC-309250](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-309250) - Naturally generated decorated pots don't drop bricks when broken with tools

[MC-309298](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-309298) - Sending chat messages while having the "Chat Delay" option set to a nonzero value can sometimes kick you from the game

[MC-309500](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-309500) - Crafting decorated pots without sherds using the recipe book creates a pot that doesn't drop bricks when broken with a tool

[MC-309565](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-309565) - Block outlines are rendered behind translucent elements if the "High Contrast Block Outlines" option is enabled

[MC-309566](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-309566) - Block outlines are rendered behind translucent elements if the "Improved Transparency" option is disabled

[MC-309743](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-309743) - The attacking animation of drowned is incorrect

[MC-310041](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-310041) - Under specific conditions, chunk loading frequently fails

[MC-310096](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-310096) - Invalid item modifiers crash the game

[MC-310098](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-310098) - Trying to mix item modifier references and inline values in a list prevents the pack from loading

[MC-310125](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-310125) - Blaze powder in brewing stands uses the cooking/speed_default number provider instead of brewing/speed_default

[MC-310133](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-310133) - Gurgles do not aim their tridents correctly

[MC-310135](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-310135) - The server crashes when requesting command suggestions for /attribute referenced from /execute

[MC-310149](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-310149) - Glass flickers when looking at it closely with the Vulkan rendering backend and the "Improved Transparency" option enabled

[MC-310163](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-310163) - The game crashes when entering exclusive fullscreen on Wayland

Get the Snapshot

Snapshots are available for Minecraft: Java Edition. To install the Snapshot, open up the [Minecraft Launcher](https://www.minecraft.net/content/minecraft-net/language-masters/download) and enable snapshots in the "Installations" tab.

**Testing versions can corrupt your world, so please backup and/or run them in a different folder from your main worlds.**

Cross-platform server jar:

[Minecraft server jar](https://piston-data.mojang.com/v1/objects/bc881a3fc6e63c490e614ab3bf9c43adc0449ab2/server.jar)

Report bugs here:

[Minecraft issue tracker](https://bugs.mojang.com/projects/MC/summary) !

Want to give feedback?

For any feedback and suggestions, head over to the [Feedback site](https://feedback.minecraft.net/) . If you're feeling chatty, join us over at the [official Minecraft Discord](https://discordapp.com/invite/minecraft) .
